decisions.name: 中信证券
reasoning: The broad-hub event was a regulatory reopening of IPO issuance after a more-than-one-year freeze, with roughly 50 companies expected to complete approval preparations by end-Jan and 760+ in the queue.

The mapping is mechanical rather than narrative: in H1, Citic Securities completed zero domestic IPOs because the channel was closed, while its refinancing underwriting market share was 11.46% and ranked first, proving existing distribution and underwriting capability.
Fresh IPO fee revenue could not yet be reported by the event week, but the regulatory quantity change directly reopens a previously blocked revenue product.
Price absorption was positive but not extreme: 20/60/120d excess versus CSI300 about +9.0/+10.8/+10.4pp.
IPO supply can also drain secondary-market liquidity, so the signal remains Research rather than High-priority.

decisions.name: 外高桥
reasoning: FTZ policy optionality was real, but direct company monetization remained insufficiently quantified.
Price absorption was extreme: 20/60/120d excess versus CSI300 about +167/+214/+422pp.
This is precisely the narrative-only policy case the market-structure route is designed to reject.
Cash-crunch and liquidity injections changed system funding conditions but created broad, offsetting effects across banks and brokers.
No uniquely quantified listed-company asymmetry was frozen that met the route's mechanical-economics requirement.

shadowControls.reason: Narrative-dominant and massively price-absorbed policy concept.
